title: Pixelart animation is maturing
author: masterblinker
selftext: I’m getting very good results lately with pixel art, doing crazy fight animations

replies.author: masterblinker
replies.body: I’m using Fable 5.2 both for drawing the character sprite, frame by frame, it’s very good at that and for directing the animation. Try it out and share your results

replies.author: CashFirm573
replies.body: It's rather clean on how he did it, let me break it down you take image of character you want then you take video of the fight animation you feed it to the AI saying i want this, it will produce it... That's how easy it is, not rocket science.

replies.author: Itadorijin
replies.body: Except everyone and their mother including me has tried this and the results aren't good or consistent.

replies.author: living_david_aloca
replies.body: So you didn’t tell it anything specific about style or movement? No sprite sheets? You literally asked it to generate the video frame by frame?

replies.author: masterblinker
replies.body: I think we are used to complicated workflows to achieve complex tasks but the secret here is Fable 5.2, for the style I researched what I liked then made images of characters with my own style and gave to the model for the animation with a fight clip reference.

comments.author: Aaron_rowe81
comments.body: do you feed in the whole fight clip or just the few seconds around the move? i'm wondering if Fable follows the timing from the reference or mostly borrows the poses. If the character art and clip have different looks, does it keep your sprite style through the action? A short hit might be easier to match than a longer exchange, where the movements change a lot. It'd be interesting to know whether the character images are enough to hold the look across the sequence, or if you have to keep steering it as it goes.

replies.author: masterblinker
replies.body: I haven’t explored it in the details of matching the motion perfectly, I would advise to try it out and let us know what challenges you faced

replies.author: Aaron_rowe81
replies.body: the impact frames are where i'd expect the sprite style to wobble first

comments.author: sfscsdsf
comments.body: what prompt did you put into Fable?

replies.author: masterblinker
replies.body: Since my replies seems not to be satisfying, I’ll try to make a post with details explained then.

comments.author: Emergency-Reply-5437
comments.body: Just tell them people how easy it is. Just let Astra 6.0 do the pixel work and then give Fable 5.2 the Graphics Astra made. Easy as that

replies.author: masterblinker
replies.body: People aren’t satisfied with that answer it seems
